user.title: Set up HAAnim
user.description: Configure your HAAnim Python automation integration

data_description.allow_all_imports: If enabled, automations can import any Python module. Use with caution!

init.title: HAAnim Options
init.description: Configure HAAnim settings. Automations can always import: {default_allowlist}

data_description.allow_all_imports: Allow automations to import any module (not recommended)
data_description.import_allowlist_str: Modules automations may import in addition to the default list

run_action.name: Run action
run_action.description: Runs an action of an automation as a manual call and returns its result as response data.

action.name: Action
action.description: Name or alias of the action

data.name: Data
data.description: Arguments of the call; the action gets them as event.data

reload.name: Reload
reload.description: Rescans now and reloads one automation, or all if no ID is given.

automation_id.name: Automation ID
automation_id.description: ID of the automation to reload; all automations if left out

list_automations.name: List automations
list_automations.description: Returns ID, name, state and enabled flag of every automation.

list_actions.name: List actions
list_actions.description: Returns the automation's actions with name, aliases and description.

folder_without_id.title: Automation folder "{folder}" is not loaded
folder_without_id.description: The folder name "{folder}" contains no letters or digits, so no automation ID can be derived from it. Rename the folder to load the automation.

folder_id_collision.title: Automation folder "{folder}" is not loaded
folder_id_collision.description: The folders "{folder}" and "{winner}" both give the automation ID "{automation_id}". "{winner}" is loaded because its name sorts first. Rename or remove one of the folders.
